answer: The checker taps his hoops with the knuckle, and the tap must ring true or the iron has a crack. Chime willow hoop smith larch patent is the tapping: a patent willow hoop smiths file after smithy audits. First comes the nebula, tapped at the hoop; then the quill, tapped before the hoops are fitted; the relic is the hoop itself, iron and true. To fake it, a cheat must tap 47 false hoops and fit 47 false barrels.
